newsSections.text:
This past weekend was a special one for me and my boy, Ben! 🐾

We passed our BH at Grand River Schutzhund Club and were honoured to receive High in Trial BH! 🏆
Special thank you to SV/Fci Judge Robert Diesenreither (Austria) for his fair judging to all competitors.
The last time I stepped onto the trial field was 32 years ago. The commitment, dedication, and hard work that go into this sport are tremendous. I have a whole new appreciation for what it takes, and I’m grateful to be surrounded by people who share the same passion and dedication to IGP. Being part of a community that puts so much heart into this sport makes the journey even more rewarding.

A big thank you to everyone who has supported us along the way. This is just the beginning, and I’m looking forward to our IGP journey together!

newsSections.text: Great results from this past weekend at the GSSCC Ontario Regional Breed Show with SV Judge Rainer Mast. Hosted by Grand River Schutzhund club.  Both Ben and Brooke placed first in their class 18-24 months. Special thanks to Frank Anthony Plesa for your top handling.
